description:
**Metric TSP Christofides construction.** The input is a complete symmetric metric distance matrix. Kruskal returns a minimum spanning tree. Its degrees identify the vertices passed to an exact minimum-weight matching over that subset.

Merge the tree and matching edges with multiplicity. The degrees become even and the combined graph stays connected. Compute an Euler walk and keep first visits to produce a Hamiltonian order.

The Python subset matching is limited to 16 odd-degree vertices in this case. The usual approximation argument applies under metric distances and exact matching. This reference does not use a general Blossom implementation.
